headline: Army warns against misleading information targeting force and chief
summary: The Bangladesh Army and ISPR have urged the public not to be influenced by baseless propaganda on social media.
details: The Bangladesh Army has reported that misleading, baseless, and motivated information is being spread across various online platforms and social media targeting the force and the Army Chief.
The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) issued a warning via a Facebook post on Saturday, October 10, urging citizens not to be influenced by such propaganda.
According to the ISPR, these efforts appear to be deliberate attempts to create confusion among the public and tarnish the image of the Bangladesh Army.
The military authority emphasized that the Bangladesh Army remains united based on a strong chain of command, mutual trust, unity, discipline, and professionalism.
The Army stated it remains firmly committed to fulfilling its duties toward the country and its people.
The public is urged to follow only official and reliable sources for any information regarding the Bangladesh Army and the Army Chief.
caption:
The Bangladesh Army has issued a warning against 'baseless' propaganda targeting the force and its chief.

The Bangladesh Army has reported that misleading, baseless, and motivated information is being spread across various online platforms and social media targeting the force and the Army Chief.

The Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) issued a warning via a Facebook post on Saturday, October 10, urging citizens not to be influenced by such propaganda.

According to the ISPR, these efforts appear to be deliberate attempts to create confusion among the public and tarnish the image of the Bangladesh Army.

The military authority emphasized that the Bangladesh Army remains united based on a strong chain of command, mutual trust, unity, discipline, and professionalism.

The Army stated it remains firmly committed to fulfilling its duties toward the country and its people.

The public is urged to follow only official and reliable sources for any information regarding the Bangladesh Army and the Army Chief.

topic: bnp to ensure security during durga puja
headline_marked: BNP [[activists to stay vigilant during Durga Puja]] to ensure peace
headline: BNP activists to stay vigilant during Durga Puja to ensure peace
summary: The party has directed its leaders and activists to act as volunteers at puja mandaps to maintain religious harmony and prevent provocative actions.
details: The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has directed its leaders and activists at all levels to remain vigilant to maintain law and order and religious harmony during the upcoming Durga Puja.

During a National Standing Committee meeting presided over by Tarique Rahman, the party emphasized the highest priority on ensuring overall security and preventing any provocative activities by 'anti-social elements'.
BNP activists will serve as volunteers at puja mandaps in coordination with local puja celebration committees to help ensure a peaceful environment.
A central Durga Puja observation committee has also been formed to monitor the overall situation nationwide.
Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi stated that the goal is to ensure the festival is completed in a joyful and festive atmosphere.

Beyond the festival, the meeting also addressed the country's economic situation, expressing deep concern over the rising prices of essential commodities and calling for the breaking of market syndicates.
The party leadership also urged the government to take a stricter role in combating drugs with a 'zero tolerance' policy to protect the youth.
Other discussions included improving waste management to control the dengue situation and revitalizing the banking sector and remittance flow.
caption:
BNP activists will serve as volunteers at Durga Puja mandaps to ensure religious harmony and prevent any unrest.

The Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) has directed its leaders and activists at all levels to remain vigilant to maintain law and order and religious harmony during the upcoming Durga Puja.

During a National Standing Committee meeting presided over by Tarique Rahman, the party emphasized the highest priority on ensuring overall security and preventing any provocative activities by 'anti-social elements'.

BNP activists will serve as volunteers at puja mandaps in coordination with local puja celebration committees to help ensure a peaceful environment.

A central Durga Puja observation committee has also been formed to monitor the overall situation nationwide.

Acting Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi stated that the goal is to ensure the festival is completed in a joyful and festive atmosphere.

Beyond the festival, the meeting also addressed the country's economic situation, expressing deep concern over the rising prices of essential commodities and calling for the breaking of market syndicates.

The party leadership also urged the government to take a stricter role in combating drugs with a 'zero tolerance' policy to protect the youth.

Other discussions included improving waste management to control the dengue situation and revitalizing the banking sector and remittance flow.
